Package in.co.rays.proj4.bean

Class UserBean

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.bean.BaseBean
in.co.rays.proj4.bean.UserBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
DropdownListBean
public class UserBean extends BaseBean
UserBean class represents user information. It stores user details such as name, login credentials, date of birth, contact information, role, login status, IP addresses, and photo.
Author:
karunaChouhan
